text: Do not let our princes accuse fortune for the loss of their principalities after so many years' possession, but rather their own sloth, because in quiet times they never thought there could be a change (it is a common defect in man not to make any provision in the calm against the tempest).
author: Niccolo Machiavelli
locator: Chapter XXIV, Why the princes of Italy have lost their states
location: Sant'Andrea in Percussina, near Florence, Italy
